author: reek
body: Design variant management. A variant shares the schematic and PCB layout but overrides component properties such as value, footprint, or do-not-populate status. Used for BOM alternatives, cost optimization, and regional variants.

author: reek
body: Apply a variant override to a component. Given a component reference designator, a field name, the original value, and a variant set, returns the overridden value if one exists, or the original.
